question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed process-wide CLI locale selection and shared localization-runtime contract before this cumulative adoption slice is considered for merge?
rationale: The patch adds a new environment-driven operator presentation contract across update, service, completion, Gateway, and UI surfaces; code review cannot determine the intended long-term locale precedence, supported-surface scope, or series acceptance policy.

options.title: Pause for RFC approval
options.body: Keep the draft series open until maintainers explicitly approve or narrow the process-locale and shared-runtime contract in the linked RFC.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed CLI-only rollout
options.body: Accept a bounded first slice after the foundation lands, limiting the contract to documented CLI output and deferring Gateway/UI adoption.

options.title: Reject the shared-runtime direction
options.body: Close the series if maintainers prefer surface-owned localization without a cross-product runtime package.

recommendation.title: Pause for RFC approval
recommendation.body: Keep the draft series open until maintainers explicitly approve or narrow the process-locale and shared-runtime contract in the linked RFC.

likelyOwner.reason: The series author can supply the contract rationale and coordinate the stated five-part sequencing, though final product direction belongs to repository leadership.
